key_directives: Follow dark architectural aesthetic strictly using #0A0B0E background and #C8A97E gold-stone accent.
Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling across the single-page layout.
Use Framer Motion for line-by-line hero reveal, scroll triggers, and tab/modal transitions.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-contact-btn', data-testid='portfolio-filter-all', data-testid='contact-form-submit').
Ensure proper font imports in index.html or CSS (@import url for Cormorant Garamond, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono).
Never use generic centered layouts or Inter font for main headings.
Use real image URLs provided in design_guidelines.json, never placeholders.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Use generous spacing (p-8, p-12, py-20, py-32) to ensure luxurious architectural breathing room.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and ensure animations run at 60fps.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast: Use sonner for form submit feedback and copy phone number action.
